name: Continuum-AI-Corp/OrcaReplay
summary: Records a coding-agent run below the harness and replays it offline from the recorded bytes, or forks it from a checkpoint onto a different model with the conversation prefix held fixed.
evidence: README documents OpenAI Responses API capture as the wire format the Codex CLI and the OpenAI Agents SDK default to, and states that a fork stays on the wire format the agent speaks.
docs/integrations.md gives per-harness notes on what each capture layer records and how the agent is pointed at the proxy.
Replay is driven from a recorded trace rather than a transcript, so a run can be re-executed or forked at a chosen step instead of only inspected.
